scope_note: Released feature-film acting appearances by Suniel Shetty (born 11 August 1961), from his debut lead in Balwaan (1992) to Welcome to the Jungle (June 2026), through the research cutoff of 28 October 2026. Includes lead, co-lead, supporting and antagonist roles, anthology segments (Darna Zaroori Hai, Dus Kahaniyaan), special and guest appearances, appearances as himself, a voice role (Delhi Safari), streaming premieres (Operation Fryday on ZEE5, Nadaaniyan on Netflix), and his work in Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Tulu, Marathi, English (Don't Stop Dreaming) and Turkish (Miras). The spine is the Wikipedia article 'Suniel Shetty filmography', whose acting credits sit in two tables (Hindi, 119 rows; non-Hindi, 14 rows); of those 133 rows, 131 are kept. Excluded: Sweetheart (1993), a short film; and Chirayu (listed as a 2011 Hindi guest appearance), which could not be verified — the only film of that name located is a 2014 Kannada release whose cast lists do not name him. Considered and not added: Ek Hindustani (2003), a lead role whose article gives a release date but which its director's own article marks unreleased; and Paltan (2018), for which he was announced but which released without him. Also excluded: producer-only credits (Bhagam Bhag, EMI, Mumbai Chakachak), web series (Dharavi Bank, Hunter Tootega Nahi Todega) and television. Six films have no Wikipedia article and rest on year lists, Box Office India, a newspaper review, a Turkish film database and a streaming listing: Raghuveer (1995), Khanjar: The Knife (2003), Miras (2008), Barood (2010), Raada Rox (2011) and 2 Chehare (2015).
